headline: Patriots' Alijah Vera-Tucker, Ben Brown ruled out vs. Bears
summary: The Patriots will be without starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown for Thursday's game against the Bears due to injuries, coach Mike Vrabel said.

headline: Injury Report Analysis: Patriots rule out five players for Thursday Night Football vs. the Bears
summary: The Patriots ruled out CB Carlton Davis III (neck), G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring), G Ben Brown (knee), CB Karon Prunty (hamstring), and CB Channing Canada (hamstring) for Thursday night in Chicago.

headline: It's Drake Maye versus Caleb Williams as the New England Patriots visit the Chicago Bears
summary: — Caleb Williams and Drake Maye have known each other for years. They were part of the same draft class, and they grew up going to the same football camps.

headline: Patriots place WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) on IR
summary: The Patriots have placed Romeo Doubs on IR.

headline: Patriots' A.J. Brown has career-high 3 dropped passes in return from injury
summary: Patriots receiver A.J. Brown, coming off a right high ankle sprain that sidelined him four weeks, had a shaky return to action Sunday, dropping a career-high three passes in the team's win over the Jets

headline: Patriots' Romeo Doubs hurt on 42-yard TD catch vs. Jets
summary: WR Romeo Doubs was hurt after diving to haul in a 42-yard touchdown pass from Drake Maye with 4:10 remaining in the first quarter.

headline: Drake Maye's 3 TD passes help Patriots stave off late push by Jets in 26-19 win
summary: — The mantra in New England's locker room under Mike Vrabel has been to never apologize for a win. So no one was feeling bad about the Patriots improving to 2-0 in the AFC East after their victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
